summary: @servicetitan/cp-api preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped obfuscated payload
details: The package's declared `preinstall` script runs `setup.mjs`, which downloads the Bun runtime binary from oven-sh/bun's GitHub releases into a temporary directory, marks it executable, and uses it to `execFileSync` the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB single-line, heavily obfuscated JavaScript program consisting of a large numeric-code lookup table and a string-array rotator with mangled `_0x`-style identifiers. npm invokes `preinstall` automatically on `npm install`, so this delivery runs unattended on every installer's host. The use of a freshly downloaded alternate runtime (Bun) to execute an opaque local blob is an alternate-runtime dropper pattern: it deliberately routes install-time code execution around scanners that only trace Node-resolved code, and the executed payload is not safely auditable due to its size and obfuscation. Regardless of the payload's ultimate behavior, the delivery shape hands the publisher arbitrary code execution on the installer's machine at install time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
